# The review loop of examples/review-loop on the real composition root, with a fake claude and no tracker, forge or network.
# The author spawns the reviewer and sends the first draft. The reviewer asks for changes, the author sends the revised draft, and the reviewer approves it.
# Each review gets the draft that the author sent, and the revise step gets the notes that the reviewer sent back.
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

example review-loop/workflow.star
example review-loop/project.star config/projects/review.star
example review-loop/prompts/draft.md
example review-loop/prompts/review.md
example review-loop/prompts/revise.md
reviewfakes

exec beehavereal check workflow review-loop/workflow.star
! stdout .
! stderr .

exec beehavereal item add review note-1 --title 'Release note' --body-file body.txt
exec beehavereal run note-1 review --workflow review-loop/workflow.star
stdout 'item note-1 finished'

exec beehavereal status
stdout 'note-1-r1\tdone'

cmp calls.log expected-calls.log

# Each of the four agent calls started in the sandbox with no network: the fake claude logs a call with no sandbox as open.
grep -count=4 '^sandboxed domains=$' sandbox.log
! grep '^open' sandbox.log

-- body.txt --
Write the release note.
-- verdicts --
changes
approve
-- expected-calls.log --
draft
review Draft 1.
revise Fix round 1.
review Draft 2.
